comment: Base bundles for USB flashing - see FLASH_PLAN.md. A bootloader MUST come from the same ESP-IDF release as the firmware: bootloadersByChip lists one per release, tagged with the idfVer string inside it, and the flasher picks the one matching the app image's idf_ver (the first is the default for an image with no descriptor). Each is the core's libs ELF patched to a DIO header via 'esptool elf2image --flash-mode dio --flash-freq 80m --flash-size 4MB'. Which ELF is what PlatformIO builds for our boards of that chip - it follows the board's flash_mode: qio_80m for the C3 and S3 boards, dio_80m for lolin_s2_mini - recorded in bootloaderVariantByChip (default qio_80m). pioarduino and the Arduino IDE share the same libs per release, so one serves both; the core named is the one it was built from. v5.5.5 for all three chips is byte-identical to a real pioarduino 3.3.12 build. Firmware from an older release is refused when provisioning, with a message to update the toolchain. Flash-size independent (esptool patches the header at write time). Partition tables are chip-independent, and are the core's stock CSVs, so they match what a PlatformIO env using the same scheme writes. boot_app0.bin is universal.
